body: Opposite route arrows are painted on the paperclip box and radio. The older arrow was scraped away beneath fresh road grit.
title: Paperclip box and walkie-talkie

body:
The room smells like the liquid from the field bottles, and Mom's throat still hurts. I opened the window; the return truck says nothing spilled.

The seedlings by the shed curled up after the spray run, and the barn cat won't go near the bottles. I put this page with the feed receipts.
title: Letter
